exposure: long-lasting episodes of maternal hypotension due to epidural/spinal anaesthesia
cohort: Neonates born from term deliveries over a 22-year period in a single level-3 medical center, specifically those diagnosed with suspected Clear Amniotic Fluid Aspiration Syndrome or Meconium Aspiration Syndrome.
finding: Clear Amniotic Fluid Aspiration Syndrome (CAF-AS) had significantly lower rates of persistent pulmonary hypertension and postnatal death compared to Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MSAF-AS), while mild manifestation rates and surfactant use were comparable between the two.
mod_finding: Hyperkinetic explosive deliveries in multiparas were identified as a specific cause of Clear Amniotic Fluid Aspiration Syndrome.
